subject: Portal role certification & evidence retention: Greenline onboarding
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Portal role certification & evidence retention: Greenline onboarding

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for kicking off the Greenline onboarding. Two asks from our side to accelerate the portal build and evidence transfer:

1) Role certification cadence and permissions model
   - We need to confirm which Greenline roles (Security Reviewer, App Reviewer, Compliance Admin) should be able to view vs. download S3 proofs. Our preference is to give the Security Reviewer view+download for CAIQ-related artifacts, and Compliance Admin full ownership.

2) Evidence ingestion & retention
   - We plan to upload CAIQ mappings and supporting artifacts to an S3 bucket and provide presigned upload URLs. Please confirm if presigned S3 uploads are acceptable and whether Greenline requires object-level encryption with a customer-managed KMS key. Also let us know your required retention TTL for retention policy metadata (e.g., 3 yrs, 7 yrs).

I've attached a first-pass CAIQ->portal field map and a role-certification template to stagger role attestations with renewals. If helpful, we can run a 30-min walkthrough next week and add this to Vendr/Whistic.

Next steps I'd like to propose:
- You confirm presign and KMS expectations
- Greenline names 1-2 initial reviewers to seed the portal
- We schedule a 30-minute handoff to map controls to evidence locations (I can share the S3 presign workflow)

Thanks —

Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships & Security Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_caiaq_map.xlsx; s3-presign-instructions.txt; redwood_role_certification_template.pdf

From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T10:05:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Portal role certification & evidence retention: Greenline onboarding

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying questions below:

1) Presigned S3 uploads
   - Yes, presigned uploads are acceptable. Our security policy requires server-side encryption; we can accept AWS-managed SSE (AES256) for onboarding artifacts. For long-term custody of SOC2 artifacts we prefer CMK (customer-managed) but for initial ingestion SSE-S3 is fine.

2) Role model and certification cadence
   - We can provide two reviewers (me and James Carter) to start. Greenline prefers an annual role certification for reviewers and a quarterly attestation for owners.

3) Retention TTL
   - Standard retention is 3 years for operational evidence, 7 years for SOC2 attestation bundles. Can you indicate which artifacts you plan to mark as "attestation" vs "operational logs" in your spreadsheet?

4) Hashing / redaction
   - For PII-containing artifacts we prefer a SHA256 hash plus redacted copy. If you provide the hash and the redacted PDF we can accept that as proof-of-possession for now.

If you can share the presign workflow and a proposed schedule I will route to our procurement/security team for the KMS exception (if we need one).

Thanks —

Sarah Lang
Senior InfoSec Manager
Greenline Health
security@greenlinehealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-12T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Portal role certification & evidence retention: Greenline onboarding

Vanessa / team — forwarding Sarah's reply and adding a short tech plan.

Plan (high level):
- Tagging model for artifacts:
  * "attestation" -> CAIQ completed templates, final SOC2 report PDF; retention = 7y
  * "operational" -> S3 logs, scans, patch reports; retention = 3y
  * "redacted" -> PII redacted PDFs + SHA256 hash stored in metadata

- Presign flow:
  1) We create a per-customer S3 prefix: s3://redwood-evidence/greenline/{year}/{control}/
  2) Backend issues time-limited presign PUT URLs (24h default; configurable)
  3) Objects uploaded with SSE-S3; if Greenline requests CMK, we can switch to SSE-KMS after procurement approval
  4) On successful upload, lambda writes metadata (uploader, hash, retention-tag) to DynamoDB for portal indexing

- Role certification automation:
  * We'll use the role_cert_template to generate quarterly reminders for owners and annual tasks for reviewers. The portal can require a two-step attestation (owner signoff + reviewer verification).

Questions for Vanessa:
- Do we want automated redaction guidance included in the S3 upload UI (i.e., warn when file names include "ssn" / "dob")?
- For DocuSign attestation: should we accept a signed DocuSign envelope as the authoritative reviewer attestation or require portal checkbox + DocuSign? My recommendation: accept DocuSign + portal checkbox (two signals).

I'll prepare the presign endpoint and a short demo (15 mins).

— Vivek
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Portal role certification & evidence retention: Greenline onboarding

Sarah —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps from Redwood:

1) I attached the CAIQ->portal mapping (redwood_caiaq_map.xlsx) and the presign instructions (s3-presign-instructions.txt). The sheet flags artifacts we consider "attestation" vs "operational" in column G.

2) We will issue presigned PUT URLs (24-hour TTL) for the first batch and encrypt with SSE-S3. If Greenline's procurement approves SSE-KMS we will rotate the prefix to use the CMK and issue new presigns.

3) Role reviewers: tagging you and James as initial reviewers. Can you please confirm James' full name and email so I can grant portal access?

4) DocuSign: Redwood will accept a signed DocuSign envelope as primary proof from the reviewer combined with a portal checkbox. That satisfies audit trails on our side.

Proposed timeline:
- Mon 6/17: 15-min presign demo (Vivek) + portal access handoff
- Wed 6/19: Greenline uploads first evidence bundle (we'll monitor and flag any compliance mismatches)

If that works, I'll schedule the demo and send the initial presign batch later this week.

Thanks —

Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships & Security Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: redwood_caiaq_map.xlsx; s3-presign-instructions.txt; redwood_role_certification_template.pdf
